blocks.text: [Updated Oct. 26, 2026, 6 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) will examine four boxes of personal belongings and electronic devices turned over by the son of a foreign national over alleged child abuse materials once they have a warrant. Earlier, police are probing a laptop discovered at the former residence of Thomas Markle Sr., the estranged father of Meghan Markle, along with images of child abuse. Thomas, whose daughter is married to Britain’s Prince Harry, had been residing in Cebu before reportedly returning to the United States earlier this year.
